coordinates: both native scanXZ and common registeredXZ; canonical physical main floorY0
purpose: Repair loss of real ground caused by narrow global histogram peaks while preserving measured evidence separation

captures.native_coordinates: scanXZ meters; native sourceY kept in floor_height_trace

filters.per_frame_floor_y_estimator: 25th percentile of candidate horizontal points in reviewed physical-zone Y range; >=15 points required; interpolated missing estimates; median5frame smoothing

evidence.exclusions: Exact synchronized-video stairs and foodcourt slope quads; conservative video-confirmed atrium opening, same as visual-floor-envelopes.json

captures.policy: Measured horizontal ground support across reviewed sourceY drift, not visual completion. No native RoomPlan floor envelope, convex hull, furniture-hole filling or unseen-wing completion. Retains every gap beyond one-cell regularization. Not obstacle-free route authority on its own; use camera traversals and clearance.
